countWithFilter(address,uint256,uint256,.details: Count the number of items for a given filter.

params._address: The address of the Generalized TCR to query.
params._count: The number of items to return.
params._cursorIndex: The index of the items from which to start iterating. To start from either the oldest or newest item.
params._filter: The filter to use. Each element of the array in sequence means: - Include absent items in result; - Include registered items in result; - Include items with registration requests that are not disputed in result; - Include items with clearing requests that are not disputed in result; - Include disputed items with registration requests in result; - Include disputed items with clearing requests in result; - Include items with a request by _party; - Include items challenged by _party.
params._party: The address to use if checking for items with a request or challenged by a specific party.

countWithFilter(address,uint256,uint256,.return: The query result: - The number of items found for the filter; - Whether there are more items to iterate; - The index of the last item of the query. Useful as a starting point for the next query if counting in multiple steps.

params._address: The address of the Generalized TCR to query.
params._filter: The filter to use. params._party: The address to use if checking for items with a request or challenged by a specific party.
params._targets: The targets to use for the query. Each element of the array in sequence means: - The page to search; - The number of items per page; - The number of items to iterate when searching; - The position from where to start iterating.

findIndexForPage(address,uint256[4],bool.return: The query result: - Index of the page, if it was found; - Whether there are more items to iterate; - If the index of the page we are searching was found.

findItem(address,bytes,uint256,uint256,b.details: Find an item by matching column values exactly. Unless specified in the _ignoreColumns parameter, finding an item requires matching all columns. - Example: Item [18, 'PNK', 'Pinakion', '0xca35b7d915458ef540ade6068dfe2f44e8fa733c'] RLP encoded: 0xe383504e4b128850696e616b696f6e94ca35b7d915458ef540ade6068dfe2f44e8fa733c Input for remix: ["0xe3","0x83","0x50","0x4e","0x4b","0x12","0x88","0x50","0x69","0x6e","0x61","0x6b","0x69","0x6f","0x6e","0x94","0xca","0x35","0xb7","0xd9","0x15","0x45","0x8e","0xf5","0x40","0xad","0xe6","0x06","0x8d","0xfe","0x2f","0x44","0xe8","0xfa","0x73","0x3c"]

params._address: The address of the Generalized TCR to query.
params._count: The number of items to iterate and return while searching.
params._cursor: The index from where to start looking for matches.
params._ignoreColumns: Columns to ignore when searching. If this is an array with only false items, then every column must match exactly.
params._rlpEncodedMatch: The RLP encoded item to match against the items on the list.
params._skipState: Boolean tuple defining whether to skip items in a given state [Absent, Registered, RegistrationRequested, ClearingRequested].

findItem(address,bytes,uint256,uint256,b.return: An array with items that match the query.

params._address: The address of the GTCR to query.

params._filter: The filter to use. Each element of the array in sequence means: - Include absent items in result; - Include registered items in result; - Include items with registration requests that are not disputed in result; - Include items with clearing requests that are not disputed in result; - Include disputed items with registration requests in result; - Include disputed items with clearing requests in result; - Include items with a request by _party; - Include items challenged by _party.

devdoc.title: GeneralizedTCRView A view contract to fetch, batch, parse and return GTCR contract data efficiently. This contract includes functions that can halt execution due to out-of-gas exceptions. Because of this it should never be relied upon by other contracts.
